Summerville, South Carolina‑based jewelry retailer announced a charitable promotion in which it donated free diamonds to active‑duty service members and veterans. The initiative, highlighted by the Post and Courier, aimed to show appreciation for military personnel through complimentary gemstone gifts. The promotion was part of the retailer’s community outreach efforts to support those who serve.
